Top 4 things to do this week
15 JUNE TO 15 SEPTEMBER
1. Join the Dubai Mallathon
Stay active with this free initiative, as the city's malls become walking and running tracks every morning.
24-28 JUNE
2. Revamp your wardrobe
Save up to 70 per cent off major fashion brands at the CBBC Summer Clearance Sale in Coca-Cola Arena.
19 JUNE TO 25 AUGUST
3. Get sporty this summer
Play cricket, football, tennis and more at Dubai Sports World, as the indoor venue returns.
THINGS TO DO
4. Explore top new attractions
Check out Dubai's latest family-friendly activities, from a Peppa-themed tour to drift go-karting.
